notes: DiscoFlate v3.54.0 — the Scenes tab is now scene-group-centric. The overlay list's title strip has a scene-group dropdown (All overlays · each group with its count · ungrouped) with ➕✏️🗑 to create, rename and delete groups, the list filters to whichever you pick, and anything you add while a group is selected joins that group. Deleting a group keeps its overlays, just untagged. Also fixed two confusing names: 'Layer order' was the same thing as the ▲▼ arrows in the list, so the duplicate numeric field is gone; 'Layer slot' had nothing to do with draw order at all — it's a named REPLACEMENT slot, so it's now called 'Replaces'.
